rationale: The original long thesis remains intact as the price has successfully tested and held support at both the session VWAP ($15.28) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($15.29). The most recent 1-minute candles show buyers stepping in off the $15.28 level with steadily increasing volume (up to 13,469 shares on the latest bar), pushing price back toward the upper end of today's range (80.9%). With the invalidation level at $15.24 still untouched and broader market sentiment strong, holding for a potential breakout above the $15.40 session high is mechanically sound.
